title: Player One Portfolio
tagline: This site — a retro-game portfolio with scroll storytelling, a 3D hero and hidden easter eggs.
description: A Vite + React single-page portfolio themed as an 8-bit game. Every section is a level, content lives in JSON data files, and heavy effects (Three.js, sound) load only when the device can handle them. Built to stay accessible and fast: keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support and AA contrast in both themes.
highlights: Scroll-driven world map + pixel transitions with GSAP ScrollTrigger
Three.js hero cube that only loads on capable devices (CSS fallback)
Content-driven: projects, certs, skills and timeline are JSON files

title: CustoMate — 3D Product Customization App
tagline: Design custom-printed products on a live 3D model, then order them — all from your phone.
description: A cross-platform mobile app for designing and ordering custom-printed products with a real-time 3D preview. Customers pick a product, drop text and images onto a 3D model (the design wraps onto the mesh instead of floating on top), then check out. A production/QC team fulfils orders through a dedicated staff workflow. Built with React Native (Expo) on a Node/Express + MongoDB API, with a companion web admin dashboard.
role: Mobile developer — 3D customizer, e-commerce flow and staff screens
highlights: Real-time 3D customizer across 7 products (t-shirt, cap, mug, tote bag, jersey, hand fan, mouse pad) with text, images, move/scale/rotate and undo/redo
AI lifestyle preview that turns a design into a product photo, plus AI design generation
Full e-commerce flow: catalog, cart, checkout, order history, GCash / Maya payments via PayMongo
Production & QC workflow with role-based staff screens and proof-photo review
Realtime order and chat updates with Socket.IO, OTP sign-up and push notifications
Known gap: the web admin side of customer chat (inbox and replies) is not built yet

title: Hotel Reservation System
tagline: Guests book rooms on the web or in an app; staff manage reservations from an admin portal.
description: A reservation system with a guest website and staff portal (Next.js on Vercel), a Flutter mobile app and a Supabase database. Guests search rooms with live availability, book with a 15-minute hold, pay at the hotel or online (GCash, Maya, cards via PayMongo), and manage or cancel bookings. Admins see arrivals and departures, record payments, handle walk-ins and moderate reviews. Booking rules are enforced in the database so the web and mobile apps can't get around them.
highlights: Two guests can never book the last room — bookings are processed one at a time
Unpaid bookings release automatically after 15 minutes
English and Filipino, 30 groups of database tests
